dish.title: Taiwanese Red-Braised Beef Noodle Soup
dish.description: Taiwan's national dish: beef shank braised for two hours in a deep, spicy broth of chili bean paste, soy, star anise, Sichuan peppercorn, cinnamon, ginger, and tomato, ladled over chewy wheat noodles with baby bok choy, pickled mustard greens, scallions, and cilantro.

recipe_version.title: Taiwanese Red-Braised Beef Noodle Soup
recipe_version.description: Taiwan's national dish: beef shank braised for two hours in a deep, spicy broth of chili bean paste, soy, star anise, Sichuan peppercorn, cinnamon, ginger, and tomato, ladled over chewy wheat noodles with baby bok choy, pickled mustard greens, scallions, and cilantro.

ingredients.name: scallions
ingredients.preparation: 4 cut into lengths for the braise, 2 sliced for garnish

ingredients.name: fresh wheat noodles
ingredients.display_name: fresh thick wheat noodles (or 12 oz dried)

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: 4 quarts, for the noodles and bok choy

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Cut the shank into chunks. Slice the ginger, smash the garlic, cut 4 scallions into lengths and slice 2, cut the onion into wedges, and quarter the tomatoes. Halve the bok choy, and rinse and chop the pickled greens.

steps.title: Blanch the beef
steps.body: Bring 12 cups (3 quarts) water to a boil in the Dutch oven, add the beef, and boil 5 minutes to release scum. Drain in a colander, rinse the beef, and wipe out the pot.

steps.title: Cook the aromatics
steps.body: Heat the oil in the pot over medium. Cook the ginger, garlic, scallion lengths, and onion 3 minutes, then stir in the doubanjiang, star anise, Sichuan peppercorns, and cinnamon stick for 1 minute, and add the tomatoes.

steps.title: Braise
steps.body: Add the beef, soy sauce, brown sugar, and 10 cups water. Bring to a boil, then cover and braise on low 2 hours, until the beef is fork-tender. Skim fat and fish out the whole spices and scallion lengths.

steps.title: Cook the noodles and bok choy
steps.body: During the last 15 minutes of the braise, bring 16 cups (4 quarts) water to a boil in the 5-quart pot (overlap stated). Then cook the noodles per the package, adding the bok choy for the last minute, and drain.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Divide the noodles and bok choy among deep bowls, ladle in the beef and broth, and top with pickled mustard greens, sliced scallions, and cilantro.
